recommendation_summary: The reply recommends a hosted heartbeat monitor for `nightly-sync`, separate from `edna`, with a small wrapper that reports start, success and failure, so the user gets an email when a run fails or never reports in.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need an alert when the nightly run fails or never starts.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker are unnecessary for this outcome.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends email only if it reaches the email step, so startup crashes stay silent.
labels.Checked myself: Based on your supplied incident details; I have not inspected the machines or verified a product.

note: The reply recommends a single hosted heartbeat alert, keeps the existing email and local logs without adding anything, and rejects the central Synology log and Docker.
